subject.title: Feature: support message read action for Telegram

question: Should Telegram `message read` expose only gateway-observed messages through a bounded plugin-owned store, and what default action gate and retention policy should it use?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how retained Telegram group content is authorized, stored, exposed, and documented.

options.title: Observed-only, default-off read
options.body: Add a bounded observed-message read path behind an explicit Telegram action gate and document that it cannot fetch arbitrary historical Telegram messages.

options.title: Observed-only, default-on for configured chats
options.body: Expose observed reads for already-configured Telegram accounts/chats by default, accepting a broader upgrade-time privacy change.

options.title: Defer to archive/plugin hook first
options.body: Keep this issue open until the passive history/plugin hook direction lands and then design `message read` on top of that contract.

recommendation.title: Observed-only, default-off read
recommendation.body: Add a bounded observed-message read path behind an explicit Telegram action gate and document that it cannot fetch arbitrary historical Telegram messages.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the latest detailed review on this issue and recently touched the source-backed Telegram action/docs snapshot.
